items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that cleans the skin without stripping or adding irritation.
A light barrier moisturizer to support comfort, since the scan shows lower moisture.
Daily mineral sunscreen helps keep the look of marks from darkening or lingering.

response.routine_note: Deep, painful lumps that leave marks are best seen by a dermatologist, so I'm not suggesting anything stronger from our shelves, and I'd avoid scrubs, peels and picking in the meantime. Until then, keep to a gentle cleanse, moisturizer and sunscreen every morning.
